articles.title_en: Climate change: What do we do about it? Economic issues regarding agricultural adaptation and mitigation
articles.title_cn: 气候变化：我们该如何应对？关于农业适应与减缓的经济问题
articles.abstract_en: Climate change will undoubtedly affect many aspects of the agricultural sector as a driver of impacts, as a force stimulating adaptation to limit or exploit climate change impacts, and as a focal point for mitigation opportunities to reduce its extent. Sectoral participants will react by undertaking a variety of adaptation and mitigation actions. Adaptation is largely inevitable but may require public action to either provide public goods or support private adaptation. Agriculture will also play an important role in mitigating climate change, as in cases it can provide low‐cost net greenhouse gas reductions. This paper will discuss the economic and physical characteristics of adaptation and mitigation actions that can be taken in the agricultural sector plus introduce some analysis results and possible directions. Clearly, across these areas, economists will find rich areas for economic inquiry.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化无疑将影响农业部门的许多方面，既是影响的驱动因素，也是刺激适应以限制或利用气候变化影响的力量，同时还是减少其程度的减缓机会的焦点。部门参与者将通过采取各种适应和减缓行动来应对。适应在很大程度上是不可避免的，但可能需要公共行动来提供公共物品或支持私人适应。农业在减缓气候变化方面也将发挥重要作用，因为在某些情况下，它可以提供低成本的净温室气体减排。本文将讨论农业部门可采取的适应和减缓行动的经济和物理特征，并介绍一些分析结果和可能的方向。显然，在这些领域，经济学家将找到丰富的经济研究领域。

articles.title_en: The capitalization of property rights to groundwater
articles.abstract_en: There is limited empirical evidence on the value of formal property rights to natural resources when they are not transferable, and there is regulatory uncertainty about enforcement. This paper takes a hedonic approach to understanding how three core features of groundwater property rights—access, allocation, and seniority—are capitalized into agricultural land values in the High Plains Aquifer region of Kansas. We find that groundwater access rights confer an average land value premium of 71%, or $1445/acre in 2019 dollars. Water rights having larger allocations and more seniority are more highly valued in the land market. The seniority effect is small but is consistent with more junior rights facing greater regulatory risk of curtailment. Taken together, these results suggest that the land market capitalizes constraints to groundwater pumping provided by groundwater property rights. We use our empirical estimates to quantify the distributional costs of modifying existing patterns of pumping, a common challenge of groundwater management organizations seeking to improve the sustainability of extraction.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于不可转让的自然资源正式产权价值，以及监管执行存在不确定性的情况下，实证证据有限。本文采用特征价格方法，理解地下水产权的三个核心特征——获取权、分配量和优先权——如何资本化到堪萨斯州高平原含水层地区的农业土地价值中。我们发现，地下水获取权赋予土地平均价值溢价为71%，即2019年美元计价的$1445/英亩。拥有更大分配量和更高优先权的水权在土地市场中价值更高。优先权效应虽小，但与较新的权利面临更大的削减监管风险一致。综合来看，这些结果表明土地市场将地下水产权对抽水施加的限制资本化。我们利用实证估计来量化修改现有抽水模式的分配成本，这是寻求提高开采可持续性的地下水管理组织面临的常见挑战。

articles.title_en: Structural transformation without industrialization? Evidence from Tanzanian consumers
articles.title_cn: 无工业化的结构转型？来自坦桑尼亚消费者的证据
articles.abstract_en: Export‐oriented industrialization was central to many Asian countries' structural transformation processes, but many African countries are bypassing industrialization, and the prospects for competing in global manufacturing markets are poor. Alternative structural transformation pathways all rely on domestic markets, and thus understanding their trajectories requires uncovering consumer preferences. Using detailed household expenditures data from a nationally representative panel survey in Tanzania, I estimate a flexible, stylized consumer demand system. I recover estimates of expenditure elasticities of demand for goods, services, and food in the aggregate, along with price elasticities of demand, identified using within‐household variation in prices and expenditures. I find that, across the expenditures distribution and in both rural and urban areas, consumer preferences are service facing. In particular, I show that (1) consumers sharply increase spending on services relative to goods and food as incomes increase; (2) demand for services in the aggregate is somewhat sensitive to changes in service prices; and (3) food, goods, and services are substitutes for each other. On one hand, a high propensity to consume the types of services that generate large local economic growth multipliers is consistent with driving growth in service sector employment. However, sustained growth in the long run may be limited because these services are low productivity and nontradable, and domestic markets are size constrained.
articles.abstract_cn: 出口导向型工业化曾是许多亚洲国家结构转型过程的核心，但许多非洲国家正在绕过工业化，且在全球制造业市场竞争的前景不佳。替代性的结构转型路径都依赖于国内市场，因此理解其轨迹需要揭示消费者偏好。利用坦桑尼亚一项具有全国代表性的面板调查中的详细家庭支出数据，我估计了一个灵活、风格化的消费者需求系统。我恢复了商品、服务和食品在总体上的需求支出弹性估计，以及需求价格弹性，这些弹性通过家庭内部价格和支出的变动来识别。我发现，在支出分布的两端以及农村和城市地区，消费者偏好都倾向于服务。具体而言，我表明（1）随着收入增加，消费者相对于商品和食品大幅增加服务支出；（2）总体上对服务的需求对服务价格的变化有一定敏感性；以及（3）食品、商品和服务彼此互为替代品。一方面，高消费倾向倾向于消费那些能产生较大地方经济增长乘数的服务类型，这与推动服务业就业增长相一致。然而，长期持续增长可能受限，因为这些服务生产率低且不可贸易，且国内市场规模受限。

articles.title_en: Integration of the US cannabis market
articles.title_cn: 美国大麻市场的一体化
articles.abstract_en: I examine the degree to which markets for cannabis are integrated using semiparametric models of spatial price linkages among US states. US attitudes toward the use of cannabis have evolved and, at the same time, laws restricting its use have been eliminated in many states. Cannabis presents the case of a unique commodity for which any interstate trade is explicitly illegal. A voluminous empirical literature has examined spatial arbitrage, trade, and market integration. Most of these studies utilize linear time series regression models. More recent work has considered increasingly more nonlinear models of market integration. I utilize fully nonlinear semiparametric generalized additive models to evaluate the spatial integration of US cannabis markets. The results confirm important nonlinearities in price relationships. Nonlinear price transmission elasticities are derived from the nonparametric modeling results. The results suggest that California cannabis markets are largely integrated with states across the nation. I find that California, which is a leading cannabis exporter, plays a price leadership role. Production of cannabis in California far exceeds the amount that can be legally grown and sold, and much of this cannabis is exported to other states. Colorado, a second primary cannabis market, generally operates in isolation from cannabis markets in other states. The likely mechanism integrating cannabis markets is the thriving trade in illegal cannabis, which has long preceded recent state‐level legislative actions that have legalized cannabis use.
articles.abstract_cn: 我使用半参数模型研究美国各州之间大麻市场的空间价格联系，以考察市场一体化程度。美国对大麻使用的态度已经演变，同时，许多州取消了限制其使用的法律。大麻是一种特殊商品，任何州际贸易都明确非法。大量实证文献研究了空间套利、贸易和市场一体化。这些研究大多使用线性时间序列回归模型。最近的研究越来越多地考虑市场一体化的非线性模型。我使用完全非线性的半参数广义加性模型来评估美国大麻市场的空间一体化。结果证实了价格关系中存在重要的非线性。从非参数建模结果中推导出非线性价格传递弹性。结果表明，加利福尼亚州的大麻市场在很大程度上与全国各州一体化。我发现，作为主要大麻出口州的加利福尼亚州扮演着价格领导者的角色。加利福尼亚州的大麻产量远远超过合法种植和销售的数量，其中大部分大麻出口到其他州。科罗拉多州作为第二个主要大麻市场，通常与其他州的大麻市场隔离。整合大麻市场的可能机制是非法大麻的繁荣贸易，这远早于最近各州立法行动将大麻使用合法化。

articles.title_en: Farm‐saved seed, royalty rates, and innovation in plant breeding
articles.title_cn: 农户留种、特许权使用费率与植物育种创新
articles.abstract_en: Seed innovation is one major factor for improving agricultural productivity. For some self‐pollinated varieties, such as wheat, farmers have the option to buy certified seed from seed dealers or to use their own farm‐saved seed. Historically, farmers could use farm‐saved seeds for free, which led to reduced incentives to innovate for private breeding companies. In recent decades, several countries have established different royalty systems for farm‐saved seeds to favor research investment. We developed a theoretical model to compare these different systems. We compared six stylized systems by analyzing their impact on incentives to innovate, as well as production efficiencies at both the seed and agricultural production levels. Our findings indicate that royalty systems allowing for a certain proportion of farm‐saved seeds result in improved welfare. The systems that lead to the highest total welfare levels are those in which the royalty level on farm‐saved seeds is regulated. This includes systems where the royalty is either directly defined by a regulator (as in the French or UK systems) or imposed to match the royalty level of the certified seeds (as in the Australian system). The Australian system performs better under high research costs. Conversely, under low research costs, the best system is either the French or the UK system, depending on the relative cost of producing farm‐saved seeds versus certified seeds. In conclusion, it is possible to design efficient royalty systems to create and produce innovation, in a context where farmers can self‐produce this innovation.
articles.abstract_cn: 种子创新是提高农业生产力的主要因素之一。对于某些自花授粉品种，如小麦，农民可以选择从种子经销商处购买认证种子，或使用自家留种的种子。历史上，农民可以免费使用留种，这导致私营育种公司的创新激励降低。近几十年来，一些国家建立了不同的留种特许权使用费制度以促进研究投资。我们开发了一个理论模型来比较这些不同的制度。我们通过分析六种典型制度对创新激励以及种子和农业生产层面的生产效率的影响，对其进行了比较。我们的研究结果表明，允许一定比例留种的特许权使用费制度能够改善福利。导致总福利水平最高的制度是那些对留种特许权使用费率进行监管的制度。这包括特许权使用费由监管机构直接定义（如法国或英国制度）或强制与认证种子特许权使用费率相匹配（如澳大利亚制度）的制度。澳大利亚制度在高研究成本下表现更好。相反，在低研究成本下，最佳制度是法国或英国制度，具体取决于生产留种与认证种子的相对成本。总之，在农民可以自行生产这种创新的背景下，设计有效的特许权使用费制度以创造和生产创新是可能的。

articles.title_en: External costs of water pollution in the drinking water supply sector
articles.title_cn: 饮用水供应部门水污染的外部成本
articles.abstract_en: Nitrate pollution from agricultural production is a major threat to water resources worldwide. This study quantifies the consequences of groundwater nitrate pollution for the drinking water supply sector by estimating the effect of groundwater nitrate pollution on the costs of water utilities. In doing so, we contribute to the estimation of the external costs of agricultural nonpoint pollution associated with drinking water supply. Empirical evidence is based on fixed effects regressions using large panel data sets on water supply companies and groundwater sampling sites in Germany. Local nitrate pollution at the abstraction plant is approximated using spatial interpolation. Our findings reveal that water suppliers incur substantial costs through groundwater nitrate pollution in terms of increased treatment and total costs. The estimated cost elasticities range from 0.048 to 0.052 for treatment costs and up to 0.019 for total costs. For an average firm, these estimates imply annual increases in treatment and total costs of €39,000 and €116,000, respectively, for a 10 milligrams per liter increase in groundwater nitrate concentrations.
articles.abstract_cn: 农业生产中的硝酸盐污染是对全球水资源的主要威胁。本研究通过估算地下水硝酸盐污染对水务公司成本的影响，量化了地下水硝酸盐污染对饮用水供应部门的后果。为此，我们为估算与饮用水供应相关的农业非点源污染的外部成本做出了贡献。实证证据基于固定效应回归，使用了关于德国供水公司和地下水采样点的大型面板数据集。取水厂当地的硝酸盐污染通过空间插值法近似得出。我们的研究结果表明，供水商因地下水硝酸盐污染而承担了可观的成本，表现为处理成本和总成本的增加。估计的成本弹性范围在处理成本方面为0.048至0.052，在总成本方面高达0.019。对于一家平均规模的企业，这些估计意味着地下水硝酸盐浓度每增加10毫克/升，年处理成本和总成本分别增加€39,000和€116,000。

articles.title_en: Double cropping as an adaptation to climate change in the United States
articles.title_cn: 美国作为气候变化适应的双季种植
articles.abstract_en: A warming climate expands the frost‐free season, plausibly allowing for increased cropping intensity in temperate regions. This paper assesses the potential of multiple cropping to offset the projected negative effects of climate change on agricultural yields in the United States. We use cross‐sectional variation in observed land cover, soil characteristics, and climate to estimate farmers' propensity to double‐crop winter wheat with soybeans. Our estimates imply that under current economic conditions, a 3°C warming would result in an increase of 2.1 percentage points in the share of current soybean area double cropped, primarily driven by expansions in cooler regions. A fixed‐effects panel model of county yields further indicates that yields of double‐cropped soybeans are about 12% lower than those of single‐cropped soybeans. Accounting for changes in cropping intensity and attendant effects on soybean yields, we project that at current prices, a 3°C warming would induce a shift in cropping intensity that increases revenue from soy systems by 1.3% overall, offsetting only a small fraction of the revenue impacts of predicted yield declines.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变暖延长了无霜期，似乎允许温带地区增加种植强度。本文评估了多季种植抵消气候变化对美国农业产量预期负面影响的潜力。我们利用观测到的土地覆盖、土壤特征和气候的横截面变异来估计农民对冬小麦与大豆双季种植的倾向。我们的估计表明，在当前经济条件下，升温3°C将导致当前大豆面积中双季种植的比例增加2.1个百分点，主要受较凉爽地区扩张的驱动。县级产量的固定效应面板模型进一步表明，双季大豆的产量比单季大豆低约12%。考虑到种植强度的变化及其对大豆产量的伴随影响，我们预测在当前价格下，升温3°C将引起种植强度的转变，使大豆系统的收入总体增加1.3%，仅抵消了预期产量下降对收入影响的一小部分。

articles.title_en: Cost misperception and voting for public goods
articles.title_cn: 成本误感知与公共品投票
articles.abstract_en: Public good provision is often determined through referendums by voters, who weigh benefits against costs. However, perceptions of benefits and costs may be incorrect, which could in turn lead to voter error and misallocation of public goods. Using real‐world referendums, we evaluate voter perceptions of the private costs of providing public goods by conducting three exit polls of New England voters and an online survey of California voters. By comparing cost perceptions to actual tax incidence, we find pervasive evidence that voters misperceive costs. Fewer than 20% of voters in our samples reported perceived costs within 25% of estimated actual costs. These findings are unsurprising given the ubiquity of opaque language explaining the financial consequences of public good referendums. In addition, our analysis suggests that actual costs have no statistical bearing on voter choice, but at least in the New England sample, voter approval is affected by perceived costs. Thus, a substantial proportion of voters are making decisions based in part on inaccurate costs, which in some cases lead to people voting against their preferences and potential misallocation of public funds. Further, researchers who match voter approval with estimated actual cost are unlikely to obtain accurate cost responsiveness or valuation estimates.
articles.abstract_cn: 公共品供给通常通过选民投票决定，选民会权衡收益与成本。然而，对收益和成本的感知可能是错误的，这进而可能导致选民错误和公共品配置不当。利用现实世界中的公投，我们通过对新英格兰选民进行三次出口民调和加州选民进行在线调查，评估了选民对提供公共品的私人成本的感知。通过将成本感知与实际税收负担进行比较，我们发现了选民普遍误感知成本的证据。在我们的样本中，只有不到20%的选民报告的成本感知在估计实际成本的25%以内。鉴于解释公共品公投财务后果的语言普遍不透明，这些发现并不令人意外。此外，我们的分析表明，实际成本对选民选择没有统计上的影响，但至少在新英格兰样本中，选民批准受到感知成本的影响。因此，相当比例的选民在做出决策时部分基于不准确的成本，这在某些情况下导致人们投票违背自身偏好以及公共资金的潜在配置不当。进一步地，将选民批准与估计实际成本相匹配的研究人员不太可能获得准确的成本响应性或估值估计。

articles.title_en: Evaluating the impact of the fourth round of China's poverty alleviation program
articles.title_cn: 评估中国第四轮扶贫计划的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study evaluates the impact of China's fourth round of the poverty alleviation program, which targeted 14 contiguous destitute areas containing 680 counties and a population of 240 million. From 2012 to 2019, China allocated a total of 813.6 billion yuan (US$126.1 billion), primarily to economic development programs within these 14 areas. Using county‐level data from 2006 to 2019, our difference‐in‐differences and difference‐in‐discontinuities estimates suggest that the program increased GDP per capita in the 14 areas by over 45% from 2012 to 2019, with substantial gains observed in both the agricultural and nonagricultural sectors. Our preferred estimates suggest that the rate of return to the program ranged from 155.8% to 165.8%. Using data from over 14,500 rural households from 2006 to 2015, we find that the program significantly elevated rural income and reduced rural poverty. Although the income growth of extremely poor households was driven more by agricultural income growth, the income growth of relatively poor households primarily resulted from nonagricultural sources.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究评估了中国第四轮扶贫计划的影响，该计划针对14个连片特困地区，涵盖680个县和240百万人口。从2012年到2019年，中国共投入813.6亿元人民币（约合126.1亿美元），主要用于这些14个地区的经济发展项目。利用2006年至2019年的县级数据，我们的双重差分和断点差分估计表明，该计划使14个地区的人均GDP在2012年至2019年间增长了超过45%，农业和非农业部门均取得了显著增长。我们的首选估计显示，该计划的回报率在155.8%至165.8%之间。利用2006年至2015年超过14,500户农村家庭的数据，我们发现该计划显著提高了农村收入并减少了农村贫困。尽管极端贫困家庭的收入增长更多由农业收入增长驱动，但相对贫困家庭的收入增长主要来源于非农业部门。

articles.title_en: Pesticide regulatory heterogeneity, foreign sourcing, and global agricultural value chains
articles.title_cn: 农药监管异质性、国外采购与全球农业价值链
articles.abstract_en: Regulations on the production and consumption of goods are very heterogeneous across countries. Whereas the effects of regulations on exports are well known, the responses of importers to heterogeneous and frequently changing country‐specific regulations are not well understood. We combine Swiss firm‐level import customs transaction data with country‐product‐year‐specific maximum residue limits to investigate the effect of pesticide regulatory heterogeneity on firm‐level imports and assess the moderating role of firm size and global value chain participation. Relying on a global sourcing model, we find that regulatory heterogeneity reduces imports but less so in larger and diversified firms. Participating in global value chains also improves firms' flexibility toward heterogeneous regulation. Business diversification—although reducing the gains from trade and scale—could help firms cope with heterogeneous international regulations.
articles.abstract_cn: 各国对商品生产和消费的监管存在很大异质性。尽管监管对出口的影响已广为人知，但进口商对异质且频繁变化的国家特定监管的反应尚未得到充分理解。我们将瑞士企业层面的进口海关交易数据与特定国家-产品-年份的最大残留限量相结合，研究农药监管异质性对企业层面进口的影响，并评估企业规模和全球价值链参与的调节作用。基于全球采购模型，我们发现监管异质性减少了进口，但在规模较大且多元化的企业中影响较小。参与全球价值链也提高了企业对异质性监管的灵活性。业务多元化——尽管减少了贸易和规模收益——可能有助于企业应对异质的国际监管。

articles.title_en: Farmers as prosumers: Evidence from cadmium‐contaminated rice in China
articles.title_cn: 农民作为产消者：来自中国镉污染大米的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study farmer responses in rice production and consumption to China's cadmium‐contaminated rice (CCR) event in 2013. We show that the CCR event reduced both rice production and consumption but did not significantly affect the quantity and price of rice sold by farmers in areas affected by cadmium pollution. Households with young children reduced their rice production and consumption by a larger amount than others, whereas the responses are reversed for households with elderly people. The decrease in rice production was mainly driven by the decrease in farmers' consumption of self‐produced rice instead of through price or income channels, indicating that farmers are prosumers who make production decisions not purely to maximize profit but also to satisfy their own consumption needs. Farmers being prosumers helped promote production side responses to new information about food safety.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了农民对2013年中国镉污染大米事件的生产和消费反应。我们表明，镉污染大米事件减少了水稻生产和消费，但并未显著影响镉污染地区农民出售水稻的数量和价格。有幼儿的家庭减少的水稻生产和消费量大于其他家庭，而有老年人的家庭的反应则相反。水稻生产的减少主要是由于农民对自产大米消费的减少，而非通过价格或收入渠道，这表明农民是产消者，其生产决策并非纯粹为了利润最大化，也为了满足自身的消费需求。农民作为产消者有助于促进对食品安全新信息的生产侧反应。

articles.title_en: Short‐run subsidies and long‐run willingness to pay: Learning and anchoring in an agricultural experiment in Ethiopia
articles.title_cn: 短期补贴与长期支付意愿：埃塞俄比亚农业实验中的学习与锚定效应
articles.abstract_en: We study how temporary provision of an agricultural innovation at zero cost affects long‐run demand for that innovation. Our experimental design enables us to distinguish between an “anchoring effect” of subsidies and a “learning effect.” We document large and persistent anchoring and learning effects. For the innovation that we consider, an integrated pest management (IPM) package for Ethiopian smallholder farmers, the learning effect dominates the anchoring effect, so temporary subsidized provision promotes long‐run technology diffusion.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了以零成本临时提供农业创新如何影响对该创新的长期需求。我们的实验设计使我们能够区分补贴的“锚定效应”和“学习效应”。我们记录了显著且持久的锚定效应和学习效应。对于我们考虑的创新，即针对埃塞俄比亚小农的综合害虫管理（IPM）套餐，学习效应主导了锚定效应，因此临时补贴提供促进了长期技术扩散。

articles.title_en: Geographical indications and welfare: Evidence from US wine demand
articles.title_cn: 地理标志与福利：来自美国葡萄酒需求的证据
articles.abstract_en: A systematic component of wine quality is believed to depend on the geoclimatic factors of its production conditions. This belief has long motivated the development of geographical indications for wines. American viticulture areas (AVAs) represent the most common geographic identifier firms use to differentiate their products in the United States. In this paper we contribute new empirical evidence on the effectiveness and impact of GIs by studying consumers' valuation of US wine appellations within a structural model of wine demand. The model is rooted in the discrete‐choice framework, under the basic premise that observable information concerning wine attributes is credible and key to consumers' choices. Specifically, we develop a two‐level, nested‐logit model featuring many wine products and characteristics—including wine type, brands, and varietals, in addition to geographic origin. The model is estimated using NielsenIQ Consumer Panel data over the 2007–2019 period. We find that US consumers place a relatively high value on wines' geographic origins, distinct from the value of brand and varietal information, as documented by their marginal willingness to pay estimates. Furthermore, a counterfactual experiment shows significant welfare impacts from information about the geographic origin of wines. Over the period of interest, the welfare gain attributable to US geographic origin designation is estimated at about $5.37 billion, with wine producers and retailers capturing ~78% of this surplus. Virtually all consumer welfare gains are due to product differentiation and increased product variety enabled by information about the wine's origin.
articles.abstract_cn: 葡萄酒质量的系统性组成部分被认为依赖于其生产条件的地理气候因素。这一信念长期以来推动了葡萄酒地理标志的发展。美国葡萄栽培区域（AVAs）是美国企业用来区分其产品的最常见的地理标识。在本文中，我们通过研究消费者在葡萄酒需求结构模型中对美国葡萄酒产区的估值，为地理标志的有效性和影响提供了新的实证证据。该模型基于离散选择框架，基本前提是有关葡萄酒属性的可观察信息是可信的，并且对消费者的选择至关重要。具体来说，我们开发了一个两级嵌套logit模型，涵盖了许多葡萄酒产品和特征——包括葡萄酒类型、品牌和品种，以及地理来源。该模型使用NielsenIQ消费者面板数据在2007-2019年期间进行估计。我们发现，美国消费者对葡萄酒的地理来源赋予相对较高的价值，这与品牌和品种信息的价值不同，正如他们的边际支付意愿估计所记录的那样。此外，一个反事实实验显示，关于葡萄酒地理来源的信息对福利有显著影响。在关注期间，归因于美国地理来源指定的福利收益估计约为5.37亿美元，其中葡萄酒生产商和零售商获取了约78%的剩余。几乎所有消费者福利收益都归因于产品差异化和由葡萄酒来源信息带来的产品种类增加。

articles.title_en: Weather shocks affect trade policy: Evidence from preferential trade agreements
articles.title_cn: 天气冲击影响贸易政策：来自优惠贸易协定的证据
articles.abstract_en: We show that weather shocks affect government trade policy decisions. We exploit variation in rainfall during the growing season within and across countries to show that weather shocks impact agricultural output and trade. Using information on tariff cuts by commodity from preferential trade agreements signed between 1995 and 2014, we then show that weather shocks that happen during the negotiation period correlate strongly with the size of tariff cuts. When weather shocks increase (decrease) a country's capacity to produce a given crop, its government negotiates a smaller (larger) tariff cut. These results are consistent with a political economy trade model with sector‐specific inputs in which the government places more weight on producers relative to consumers in its objective function. They also reveal that governments update their beliefs about domestic agricultural production capacity in response to weather shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明天气冲击影响政府贸易政策决策。我们利用生长季节内和国家间降雨量的变化来显示天气冲击影响农业产出和贸易。利用1995年至2014年间签署的优惠贸易协定中按商品划分的关税削减信息，我们进一步表明，谈判期间发生的天气冲击与关税削减幅度密切相关。当天气冲击增加（减少）一个国家生产特定作物的能力时，其政府谈判的关税削减幅度较小（较大）。这些结果与一个具有部门特定投入的政治经济贸易模型一致，在该模型中，政府在其目标函数中对生产者的权重高于消费者。它们还揭示，政府会根据天气冲击更新其对国内农业生产能力的信念。
